query:
SELECT 'users' as tbl, COUNT(*) as total FROM users
UNION ALL SELECT 'investments', COUNT(*) FROM investments
UNION ALL SELECT 'nodeOrders', COUNT(*) FROM nodeOrders
UNION ALL SELECT 'referrals', COUNT(*) FROM referrals
UNION ALL SELECT 'notices', COUNT(*) FROM notices;

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_users,
  SUM(CASE WHEN walletAddress IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wallet_users,
  SUM(CASE WHEN totalInvested > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as investors,
  SUM(totalInvested) as total_invested_usdt,
  SUM(totalNodes) as total_node_value
FROM users;

SELECT u.walletAddress, u.totalInvested, u.totalNodes, u.createdAt
FROM users u
WHERE u.totalInvested > 0 OR u.totalNodes > 0
ORDER BY u.totalInvested DESC
LIMIT 10;
